answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Burn a non-refundable 500-unit deposit per registration; bulk cloning is pure loss. A ivory of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the cipher of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and ocean-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
